title: Merchant rules
intro: Rules sort imported movements by merchant. They are learned when you confirm an import or change a category for the future, and you can write your own.

error.title: The rules could not be loaded.
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No rules yet.
empty.body: They appear as you confirm imports, or write one yourself.

hits: {count, plural, =0 {No matches yet} one {# match} other {# matches}}

deleteSheet.title: Delete this rule?
deleteSheet.body: Movements already sorted keep their category. Next imports stop matching “{pattern}” this way.

toast.applied: {count, plural, =0 {No movement in review matched this rule.} one {# movement categorised.} other {# movements categorised.}}
toast.savedApply: Rule saved. Apply it to the movements in review?

matchHelp.merchant: The merchant name, ignoring capitals and numbers.
matchHelp.contains: Any bank description that contains this text.
matchHelp.regex: A regular expression over the bank description, for advanced cases.

form.locked: A bank default: it keeps matching “{pattern}” the way the bank writes it. You can change what it does.
form.paidByHint: Optional. Who pays the movements it matches.
form.payeeHint: Optional. The name the movements it matches get.
form.priorityHint: When several Contains or Pattern rules match, the highest priority wins.

problems.targetRequired: Choose a category or a transfer account.
